query:
SELECT 
                    g.id,
                    g.name,
                    g.avatar_url,
                    m.role,
                    m.joined_at,
                    ms.remark,
                    ms.mute_notifications,
                    ms.nickname_in_group,
                    ms.is_top,
                    ms.recall_notification,
                    ms.show_nickname,
                    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM group_members WHERE group_id = g.id) as member_count
                FROM groups g
                JOIN group_members m ON g.id = m.group_id
                LEFT JOIN group_member_settings ms ON g.id = ms.group_id AND m.user_id = ms.user_id
                WHERE m.user_id = $1
                AND (g.name ILIKE $2 OR g.description ILIKE $2 OR ms.remark ILIKE $2)
                ORDER BY g.name
                LIMIT $3 OFFSET $4
